description: The docker run line that publishes a container port to the host, using the -p HOST:CONTAINER flag.

steps.description: Run the Open WebUI image detached with `-d`, name the container `webui`, and publish the port with `-p 3000:8080`. The page says a containerized server listens on a port inside the container, invisible to your browser until you publish it.

The comment reads the mapping: Open WebUI listens on 8080 inside, and your browser visits `http://localhost:3000`. The page says to read `-p 3000:8080` as host port 3000 forwards to container port 8080, and the host side is yours to choose.

title: Publish a Container Port
